task: register for a class through a school's registration portal (university and community-college student portals, community-ed sites): search the course catalog, check open seats and schedule fit, add the course to the cart or schedule, enroll and pay if required; complete when the enrolled schedule or registration confirmation is on screen. Surface pinned: a web registration portal. Variants: applying for admission, financial-aid forms, and buying self-paced MOOC courses (Udemy, Coursera) do not belong.

tree.label: Register for classes
tree.note: do 1, with 2 wherever the platform puts its gates - before anything (oQot, _Bk5), at the registration door (GHzX), or as a first-time sequence that spans days (Kz25). repeat 3, 4, and 5 per course until the schedule is staged - 5 is a no-op on direct-commit systems, where 4 leads straight into 6 (Y3_T, Fk8A, eNaE, Kz25). then 6; every rejection in the corpus surfaces there, and 6.5 reaches back into 3 and 4. 7 after 6 and again after every mutation. 8 where the schedule needs changing - it re-enters 6's machinery (9q6O). 9 when money exists at all: as context before (mXIo), as a hold inside 6 (Kz25), as a chained bill after (oQot, eNaE), or as the commit itself (GhTo).
